name: Crystal
author: E. T. Carter
description: The view from inside a cut gem: large translucent facet planes stack across the whole frame, each one an internal reflection of a single studio lamp and strip light, dimmer and cooler the deeper it sits. Facet seams run as hard bright lines with dispersion fringes, red on one flank and blue on the other, and the stone turns slowly so the reflected lamp sweeps facet to facet in flashes of fire.

params.label: Facets
params.effect: Number of facet planes in each fold set; low is a few huge shards, high a dense cut.

params.label: Dispersion
params.effect: Colour split at the facet seams and reflected lamps; 0 is achromatic glass.

params.label: Turn
params.effect: How fast the stone turns and the lamp sweeps across the facets; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Clarity
params.effect: Light kept per internal reflection; low is a dark included stone, high is flawless and bright.

params.label: Facet size
params.effect: Size of the facet planes against the frame; low packs in more seams.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer shifts the viewpoint inside the stone; 0 ignores the mouse.
